adopt:
pip install "awdk>=3.8.74"
adk free-cloud up            # pinned FreeLLMAPI image on 127.0.0.1:3001 (docker or podman)
# open http://127.0.0.1:3001, add YOUR provider keys, copy the unified key
adk keys set freellmapi      # stays on this machine
adk free-cloud enable        # or: adk free-cloud enable --url http://host:3001
# Desktop app user? skip `up`: awdk finds it on :31415.
description:
Kind: pack

What it does
Free cloud (your own free-tier keys): run FreeLLMAPI locally and make it awdk's non-local route -- local model first, your free tiers next, paid API last. Bring your own provider keys; their terms apply.
